label: Episode 2 · The Gazebo
title: We’re Transforming Our Old Gazebo Into a Luxury Pool Retreat!
description: Our old family gazebo in Uganda is getting a new chapter. Follow the build from its foundations and roof frame to the plans for an upstairs lounge and bar, a gathering space downstairs, and Kizmari’s signature arches.

label: Episode 1 · The Office
title: We Turned a Storeroom Into Our Dream Office
description: An unused storeroom becomes the hub of all things Kizmari. Come along from the early drawings and installation work to the finished office, with its logo wall, handmade pots, artwork, and the arches that bring the room together.

label: Meet Kizmari · The Introduction
title: Nobody Believed We Could Build This In Africa
description: Meet the family behind Kizmari Luxury Villas and the dream we have carried for more than ten years. Our introduction shares the vision for the villas in Uganda, our love of African design, and the journey of bringing it all to life.
